bandwidth_scope: Array-size accounting, each array read once and output written once; not measured DRAM traffic. Cache effects, coalescing and repeat reuse are not modeled.

definition.change: same FP64 color order; serial no-interface distinct-source path skips copy and queues sweeps, otherwise one fence per sweep with original interface path
definition.timing: exclude first two steps and last write step; alternate order

pressure.scope: Kernel events, 5 rounds, 3 packing repetitions and 20 SpMV/residual repetitions per round. Allocation, host transfer, global x exponent scan and CPU validation excluded. Row exponent selection included in packing. Integer kernels write FP64 result; floating kernels write native result. Separate untimed integer launches also save raw accumulators for exact CPU validation. This is not full CFD.

temperature.scope: Kernel events, 5 rounds, 3 packing repetitions and 20 SpMV/residual repetitions per round. Allocation, host transfer, global x exponent scan and CPU validation excluded. Row exponent selection included in packing. Integer kernels write FP64 result; floating kernels write native result. Separate untimed integer launches also save raw accumulators for exact CPU validation. This is not full CFD.

phase_source_scope: S_i=alpha_i*(sum_j(alpha_j*dgdt_j)-dgdt_i) evaluated at simultaneous final states, multiplied by dt; not a sequential alpha replay.
scope: MAIN short-run engineering screen; not user acceptance or physical-model validation. Integer kernels are separate from full CFD. Device-wide power includes desktop processes.
